name: Chroma
note: Chroma Cloud: $0.33/GiB-month stored · $2.50/GiB written via add, update or upsert · no minimum on the usage-based Starter plan. Billed in GiB, not GB. Reads are priced separately at $0.0075/TiB queried plus $0.09/GiB returned, which this calculator does not model.

sources.label: Chroma Cloud pricing (docs)
sources.note: Storage is prorated hourly and writes are metered per "logical GiB" — Chroma's term for the size of the data as written, not the size on disk after indexing.

sources.label: Chroma pricing page
sources.note: Same rates as the docs. Adds the plan structure: Starter is $0/month usage-based, Team is $250/month including $100 of usage.
